entries.zh: 困倦欲睡；疲累得支持不住、几欲倒下
entries.en: to be drowsy from exhaustion; to nod off from fatigue and nearly fall over

entries.zh: 行房；夫妻同床（婉指夫妇性事）
entries.en: for husband and wife to sleep together; to have marital relations

entries.zh: 直挺挺地睡；仰面伸直而卧（如尸般僵直）
entries.en: to sleep stretched out straight, stiff as a corpse
entries.notes: L 明作 derecho（直），H 疑为 張尸/挺屍 类俗写，M 次音节 go 与 死(si) 不合，姑依 L 定「伸直而睡」。

entries.zh: 打盹做梦；睡梦（睡着而有所梦）
entries.en: to doze and dream; to dream in one's sleep

entries.zh: 睡觉；就寝
entries.en: to sleep; to go to bed
entries.notes: L 作 dormirar（疑 dormitar 之讹），H 次字疑 遍/邊，仅据 眠 取「睡」义。

entries.zh: 半睡半醒；打盹
entries.en: half asleep and half awake; to doze

entries.zh: 尚未入睡；睡意未至
entries.en: not yet asleep; before sleep has come on

entries.zh: 打盹；寤寐之间（半醒半睡）
entries.en: to doze; to drowse between waking and sleeping
entries.notes: M 栏 goi gy 与 寤寐 常读不合（疑记音有误），L/H/R 三者相合。

entries.zh: 卧室；寝室（旧义亦指修道院之集体寝舍）
entries.en: bedroom; sleeping room (also a religious house's common dormitory)

entries.zh: 二；两（数目）
entries.en: two (the number)

entries.zh: 两个一起；皆（两者俱）
entries.en: two together; both
entries.notes: R 栏 guiay 与 皆 之官话常读不合，取 H 皆 与 L dos juntos 相合之义。

entries.zh: 更（夜间计时单位，一更约两小时）
entries.en: a watch of the night (about two hours)

entries.zh: 二（序数用法：第一、第二之第二）
entries.en: two, used in ordinal counting: the second

entries.zh: 丑（十二时辰之二，半夜一时至三时）
entries.en: chou, the second earthly branch (the double hour c. 1-3 a.m.)

entries.zh: 未（十二时辰之八，午后一时至三时；此指午后二时）
entries.en: wei, the eighth earthly branch (c. 1-3 p.m.); two o'clock in the afternoon

entries.zh: 两类人；两等人（起＝等类、批次）
entries.en: two kinds or classes of men

entries.zh: 枕边话；夫妇枕畔私语（两首共一枕）
entries.en: pillow talk; words whispered between husband and wife on the pillow
entries.notes: H 两字均带 [疑]（枕/抳、邊/遍），然 L 与 M/R 皆指「枕邊話」，义可定。

entries.zh: 两样颜色；两种花色（双样色）
entries.en: two colours; of two different colours
entries.notes: H 双 为 雙 之异写，[疑] 仅关字形，L/H/M 义一致。

entries.zh: 四肢；四体（两手两脚）
entries.en: the four limbs (two hands and two feet)

entries.zh: 四肢（同前条，字作 肢）
entries.en: the four limbs
entries.notes: 与第 19 条同义，H 作 四肢（19 作 四体）。

entries.zh: 半片；一宗（货物或一份额）之两半
entries.en: two halves of one lot or piece; a half piece
entries.notes: R 栏残缺，然 L 与 H 半片、M poa peng 相合，义尚可定。

entries.zh: 两次；二回（原件汉字与音写栏皆空白，中文词形无存）
entries.en: twice; two times (Chinese columns blank in the original)
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏皆 [空]，仅存西语词头，中文词形与读音无存，释义存疑。
